name: media-between-text
title: Media Between Text
description: A headline-sized sentence whose middle brackets widen on hover to slide in a photo or video, then close again when the pointer leaves. It can also open on scroll into view or on a ref call.
use: A single striking headline on a landing page should carry a photo or clip inside the copy itself.
avoid: The hidden media gives no hint it is there, so on touch screens the effect never triggers.
a11y: Hover is the only default trigger and the sentence is not focusable, so keyboard users cannot open the media. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One line of large, light-weight coral text with a bare pair of brackets mid-sentence, on a black stage above a tiny grey hint. Opened, a small landscape photo fills the space the brackets frame and the words spread to either side.
behaves: On hover the gap between the brackets widens over about half a second on a spring to reveal the media, and leaving shrinks it back to nothing. A configured scroll-into-view or a ref call can play the same opening without a pointer.
customise: Set the two text halves, the media URL and type, and the trigger through props; the reveal width, duration and spring live in the variants, and the media box size comes from a class.
weight: light: Two text nodes and one image or video that only animates while hovered.
demo: The line "that's a nice ( ) view!" with a mountain photo at sunrise.
issues: The media box has no intrinsic size, so without a width and height class the picture never shows.
Closed, the empty brackets read like a typo unless the tiny hint line explains the hover.
polishWhy: Striking inline reveal with a smooth spring; the bare brackets look odd until hovered.
